name: The Mayflower, Jakarta - Marriott Executive Apartments
short_description: Long-stay Marriott Executive Apartments in Jakarta's Sudirman CBD, offering 1-, 2- and 3-bedroom serviced suites with full kitchens, laundry and full hotel service, steps from Setiabudi Astra MRT.
ai_summary: The Mayflower is a Marriott Executive Apartments (MEA) property built for extended stays: roughly 96 furnished suites across six layouts, from One-Bedroom Superior to Three-Bedroom Executive, each with a full kitchen (induction cooktop, oven, dishwasher, double-door fridge), washing machine and a separate living area. It sits atop Sudirman Plaza / Indofood Tower on Jalan Sudirman, about 20 metres from the Setiabudi Astra MRT station, making it strongly favoured by business travelers and relocating expatriates. TripAdvisor shows roughly 4.0/5 across about 405 reviews (ranked mid-pack among Jakarta hotels), while other platforms skew higher (~4.3-4.5). Reviewers consistently praise the spacious suites, city views, attentive and personable staff (free upgrades are frequently mentioned), and the high-floor indoor pool, jacuzzi, gym, sauna and spa. Dining centers on The Cafe, which serves an a-la-carte rather than buffet breakfast; guests note the cafe space is small and can create a wait at peak times, and a few mention tired furnishings and dim evening lighting in some units. Rates (from around IDR 1 million) are widely seen as good value for the space and location.

High-floor indoor pool, jacuzzi, gym, sauna and spa
cons: The Cafe is small; a-la-carte breakfast can mean a wait at peak times

research_highlights: Marriott Executive Apartments format: ~96 units, six suite types (1BR Superior up to 3BR Executive) with full kitchens
Directly above Sudirman Plaza with Setiabudi Astra MRT station essentially at the door
research_watchouts: Breakfast is a-la-carte at The Cafe, not a buffet, and may be included for a limited number of guests per booking
Airport distance is an approximation from mapping (~27 km to CGK), not an official Marriott figure

faqs.question: Do the apartments have full kitchens for long stays?
faqs.answer: Yes. As a Marriott Executive Apartments property, every suite has a full kitchen (induction cooktop, oven, dishwasher, double-door refrigerator) plus a washing machine and separate living area, suiting extended and family stays.

faqs.question: How close is it to public transport and the CBD?
faqs.answer: It sits above Sudirman Plaza / Indofood Tower on Jalan Sudirman, roughly 20 metres from the Setiabudi Astra MRT station, in the heart of Jakarta's central business district.

faqs.question: What facilities are on-site?
faqs.answer: A high-floor indoor swimming pool with jacuzzi, a children's pool, gym, sauna, steam room and a spa, plus The Cafe restaurant serving breakfast and all-day dining.

reviews.title: Review The Mayflower Jakarta - Marriott Executive Apartments
reviews.author: Ludyah Annisah
reviews.summary: Blogger stayed in an ~80 sqm One-Bedroom Executive Suite (a free upgrade). Praises the well-equipped kitchen, scenic high-floor pool and jacuzzi, MRT proximity and value (~IDR 1M). Notes The Cafe's a-la-carte breakfast and small space.

reviews.title: Jakarta: Staying at The Mayflower - Marriott Executive Apartments
reviews.author: The Yummy Traveler
reviews.summary: Blogger stayed in a One-Bedroom Superior suite and enjoyed it, highlighting the strategic Sudirman Road location and on-site spa, gym, indoor pool and restaurant as key plus points for the serviced-apartment stay.
